WITH filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1217 AND 1217 + 11
),
aggregated_data AS (
    SELECT i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name, d_year, d_qoy, d_moy, s_store_id, SUM(COALESCE(ss_sales_price * ss_quantity, 0)) AS sum_sales
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN filtered_dates ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    JOIN item ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk
    JOIN store ON ss_store_sk = s_store_sk
    GROUP BY i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name, d_year, d_qoy, d_moy, s_store_id
),
ranked_data AS (
    SELECT i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name, d_year, d_qoy, d_moy, s_store_id, sum_sales, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i_category ORDER BY sum_sales DESC) AS rk
    FROM aggregated_data
)
SELECT * FROM ranked_data WHERE rk <= 100 ORDER BY i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name, d_year, d_qoy, d_moy, s_store_id, sum_sales, rk LIMIT 100
